note: City of Zumbrota 80-acre park along the Zumbro River; the camping spurs line the park road on the north side of the park, with grass sites at utility posts. --Claude
summary: City camping page read: first come, first served May 15 - October 15 (stored derived close 11-01 corrected), $40 electric/water, $50 with sewer, tents $25, showers and waste station; the city added 10 sites and a bathhouse from summer 2024. Pin is ~550 m off in the open park south of the campground; not waterfront kept.
flags: PIN: stored 44.29720,-92.67130 sits in the open lawn of the south park near the river path, with no campsites. On imagery the camping spurs (RVs parked on gravel pull-offs) line the park road in the NW part of the park, centred about 44.3011,-92.6756 (~550 m NNW of the stored pin). Recommend moving the pin to 44.3011,-92.6756.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The nearest RV spurs (about 44.3009,-92.6766) are ~50 m from the Zumbro River with a continuous tree band between, and the rest sit 80-150 m back along the road; no open ground to the water.
Phone 507-732-7313 confirmed as the camp host's number on the city camping page (City Hall 507-732-7318). Website is the city's own camping page: fine.
Expansion: the city's project page says the Park Board approved adding 10 campsites and a new bathhouse, 'set to commence in early Summer 2024'; the site count is not published, so none written.
